## Documentation

The decision of a guard bot about a join request of the current user.

It follows a [`GuardBotApprovalRequired`](../../errors/exceptions/other/guard-bot-approval-required.md) raised by [`join_chat`](../../methods/chats/join_chat.md).

### Parameters

- **`chat`** ([`Chat`](Chat.md))
  The chat the user asked to join.

- **`query_id`** (`int`)
  Identifier of the join request, as in [`GuardBotApprovalRequired`](../../errors/exceptions/other/guard-bot-approval-required.md).

- **`type`** ([`ChatJoinResultType`](../../enums/ChatJoinResultType.md))
  The decision.

- **`url`** (`str`, *optional*)
  URL of the Web App to open, for `WEB_APP` only.
